articles.title: Egypt's Soccer Team Gets a Hero's Welcome After Their Best World Cup Ever!
articles.summary: Hundreds of fans waving flags cheered Egypt's soccer team in el-Alamein after their best World Cup run. They made it to the last 16 for the first time, and captain Mohamed Salah promised a new beginning.

articles.title: A Super Strong El Niño Is Coming—Here's What That Means for You
articles.summary: Scientists say this year's El Niño could be one of the strongest ever, with an 81% chance of reaching the top category. It's already breaking records and could bring wild weather like floods, droughts, and heat waves.

articles.title: Could Your School Lose Internet? A Big Program That Pays for It Is in Danger
articles.summary: The FCC is reviewing a program that helps schools and libraries afford internet. Educators worry funding could be cut, which might force districts to pay tens of thousands of dollars more each month.
